svg.aria-label: Scatter of 1123 champions across 41 environments with a measurable spread, plotting self-reported against measured score, each standardized within its environment, with a solid grey y=x perfect-calibration reference line. 265 points more than 0.05 z off the diagonal are drawn larger and darker; points below the line are over-claims, above are under-claims.
